items.title: Chuck Mancuso interviewed by Monk Rowe, Buffalo, New York, October 10, 2013
items.q: He’d go, “You ain’t no Cary Grant but you sure will be able to dress well.”

ctx.x: Always sharp. Yeah. Because of them. And Uncle Bay was pretty slick. He’d go, “You ain’t no Cary Grant but you sure will be able to dress well.”
Was there an Italian musical tradition in your family, in the circle?
